The '''"Smokescreen" stealth system''' was a type of [[Optical camouflage system/Legends|optical camouflage system]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]] enhancement available in the period after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The system was produced by [[Atlas Corp]] and cost 5500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].
